name: Your Company
tagline: A pool where swimming is taught calmly and properly
niche: Pool and swim school: kids from 4, adults, aqua fitness

listing.description: A website for a pool, swim school or water park. Living water on the first screen, programmes as swim lanes, a day-by-day timetable and memberships.

seo.title: Your Company — pool and swim school in Tashkent
seo.description: A 25-metre pool on Ulugbek Street: swimming lessons for kids from 4 and adults, lap swimming, aqua fitness. Trial lesson, memberships, coaches with medical clearance.
seo.answer: Your Company is a 25-metre pool at 56 Mirzo Ulugbek Street in Tashkent. We teach kids from age 4 and adults from scratch, and offer lap swimming and aqua fitness. Weekdays 07:00–22:00, weekends 08:00–20:00. A single visit is 80,000 sum, a monthly membership from 600,000 sum, a kid’s trial lesson 50,000 sum.

sections.title: Swimming made easy
sections.subtitle: Six lanes, water at +28 °C and coaches who teach without shouting. Kids from 4, adults from scratch, early-morning lap swimming.

sections.label: About
sections.title: Water you want to stay in
sections.text: Your Company opened in 2016 as a kids’ swim school and grew into a full pool: 25 metres, six lanes and a separate warm pool for little ones. The water is cleaned with ozone and UV, so it hardly smells of chlorine. We test the water every day, and the results hang by the entrance.

sections.label: Programmes
sections.title: A lane for everyone
sections.intro: Groups of up to 6, lessons are 45 minutes. The first lesson is a discounted trial.

items.title: Little ones 4–6
items.text: Warm pool, water games, breathing and first strokes. Parents can watch from the stands.

items.title: Kids 7–14
items.text: Four strokes, starts and turns. For those aiming at sport, there’s a squad trial.

items.title: Adults from scratch
items.text: For those afraid of water or who never learned. In 12 lessons — a confident 25 metres of freestyle.

items.title: Aqua fitness
items.text: A workout to music in shallow water: gentle on joints, noticeable for muscles.

items.title: Lap swimming
items.text: Lanes by pace: slow, medium, fast. Mornings from 07:00.

sections.label: Coaches
sections.title: Who will be in the water with you

items.quote: My son was scared even to wash his face; two months later he jumps in off the side himself. The coach never once raised her voice.
items.author: Nigora

items.quote: Learned to swim at 38. Twelve lessons and I swim the length without stopping.
items.author: Otabek

items.q: Do I need a medical certificate?
items.a: Yes, a certificate from a GP or paediatrician clearing you for the pool, valid for 6 months. Any clinic can issue it.

items.q: From what age do you take kids?
items.a: From age 4 in the “Little ones” group. Younger children can have one-to-one lessons with a parent in the warm pool.
Swimwear, a cap, flip-flops and your certificate. We provide a towel and locker.
The monthly membership can be frozen for up to 7 days on request, or for the length of an illness with a doctor’s note.
Yes, free courtyard parking for 30 cars.

sections.label: Contact
sections.title: Come for a trial lesson
sections.text: Send us the age and a convenient time on Telegram — we’ll pick a group and send the timetable. A kid’s trial lesson is 50,000 sum, an adult’s 80,000 sum.
